title: Demo: landing mockups

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: So I put together two versions of the first screen. One is a big headline with a screenshot of the app, the other is a live example.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Daisy writes an email right there on the page. Someone says “tell Masha the call moves to Thursday”, and a second later the text is ready.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: I like it. Nobody looks at app screenshots, but an email makes sense at once.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: That’s what I think too. Just keep the animation under five seconds, or nobody scrolls down to the button.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Agreed. And no “revolutionary AI assistant”, please. Just: you talk, Daisy writes.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: I already crossed that headline out. So the copy is yours?

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: It’s mine. And let’s show it to Masha — she’s the best at spotting where we oversell.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: Sure. She needs time, though: send it by Friday so we can still fix things.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Okay, by Friday. When can you show the mockup?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: The first screen by Thursday. I’ll leave the other blocks alone and redo them after the copy.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: Great. So Thursday we look at the mockup, Friday we get Masha’s notes.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.text: And keep the call short, like today. This one could have been an email, honestly.

lines.speaker: me
lines.text: At least Daisy got it all down. Thanks, Anna!

summary: Agreed to show on the landing’s first screen how Daisy writes an email; check the copy with Masha by Friday.
